name: combine slopes sampled at trial points inside the step
mechanism: evaluate the rate at the current state, use it to reach a trial point part-way through the step, evaluate again there, repeat for a fixed number of stages, and advance by a fixed weighted combination of the sampled slopes chosen so low-order errors cancel

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Runge–Kutta methods' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Differential equation solving:

requires: a rate function evaluable at trial states
fails_when: several rate evaluations per step; explicit forms still fail on stiff problems
